ModMetaData.name: Dress Up Colonist: New & Improved
ModMetaData.author: Willow
ModMetaData.description:
■ About Dress Up Colonist allows you to fully customize the visual appearance of your colonists' clothing, headwear, and animal models without affecting their actual stats or performance.
■ Features & What's New - **Visual Overrides:** Swap apparel, gear, and hats to look like any item in the game with clean UI menus. - **Animal Model Overrides:** Turn your colonists into animals (fully compatible with modded animal races) complete with dedicated reset controls. - **Ideology Style Selection:** Choose alternate style variants with live icon previews. - **Body Type Customization:** Fine-tune visuals across different adult body shapes using icon grids with tooltip labels. - **Full Loadout Copy & Paste:** Clone entire outfit setups, colors, styles and layer offsets between colonists instantly with Copy All / Paste All. - **Basic Material Defaults:** Newly generated overrides spawn unstyled and default to baseline materials like steel or cloth automatically. - **Improved Stability:** Updated for RimWorld versions 1.5, 1.6, and 1.7 with fixed Harmony integration, safe helmet/apparel checks, and cleaned-up localization.
